address.note: The <name>.onion file is written into the mounted key volume, so a consumer can read it directly with no hiddenforge installed. `show --json` is the same value with the name and key path attached.

description: Hardened Tor v3 onion-service sidecar: expose any backend as a .onion hidden service.

env.note: The entrypoint resolves backend hostnames to IPs at startup and re-checks them every 30s; if a backend moves to a new IP it exits so the restart policy restarts it with a fresh lookup; a backend that did not resolve at startup is configured the same way once it does. Keep a restart policy on the service.

optional.TOR_SANDBOX: 1 (default) | 0 - set 0 only where the kernel or runtime refuses to install Tor's filter at all

required.<NAME>_TOR_SERVICE_HOSTS: onion_port:backend_host:backend_port[,...] - one hidden service named <name> (lowercased, underscores become hyphens), several onion-side ports. This is the native full form.

simple.--backend: in `hiddenforge setup`: host:port shorthand that emits 80:<host>:<port> under <NAME>_TOR_SERVICE_HOSTS

exit_codes.1: refused or failed (see stderr / the --json error field)
exit_codes.3: a key appeared at the output path while a search was running
exit_codes.4: not ready yet (status --json: the hidden service is not published)

health.podman_note: No healthcheck under Podman: rootless Podman 4.9 never restarts a container that has one when no systemd user session is reachable, and restarting is how this container recovers. `status` runs the check itself.
health.poll: Poll `hiddenforge status --json` and publish nothing until `ready` is true. Read the address with `hiddenforge show --json`.

states.hidden_service_reachable: established introduction circuits AND the descriptor uploaded to the network by this Tor, for every service
states.process_up: a Tor process exists in the container
states.ready: running AND healthy AND published - never false-positive

secret.format: 96 bytes: 32-byte '== ed25519v1-secret: type0 ==' tag + 64-byte Ed25519 secret

key.warning: The key IS the .onion address. Losing it loses the address permanently; there is no recovery and no reset. Encrypt backups.

name: hiddenforge

networks.note: Attach the backend to tor-internal only. tor-internal is internal:true (no egress, not host-reachable). hiddenforge joins tor-internal (to reach the backend) and tor-external (for Tor).

tmpfs.note: ephemeral; the hidden_service bind mount overlays it

volumes.purpose: persistent hidden-service keys and the published address(es)
